newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling slightly ahead of Eid.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling slightly ahead of Eid.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may edge downwards when the market reopens after Monday's public holiday, brokers said.

"There may be a few fresh commitments today. But we have a good number of selling orders. Selling pressure is expected to continue because people may need to cash in their shares ahead of Moslem Eid al-Adha festival later this week," said Golam Sarwar of Mahbub Morshed and Company.
The DSE all-share price index closed 18.20 points or 1.64 percent down at 1,089.09 on turnover of 44.4 million taka on Sunday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
